WORK EXPERIENCE
Designation: Senior Independent testing and validation specialist (Assistant Vice president) Department: Risk Management (Internal Controls) Company: Wells Fargo International Solutions Pvt Ltd (January ‘2025 – June 2026)
Roles and Responsibilities





•


Engage in 2nd Line of Defense risk management projects or namely Issue Management, Control Monitoring activities, Risk and Control Assessments, to name a few. Lead or participate in moderate to high risk or complex review activities in a matrixed environment and communicate emerging risks to management within Independent Testing. Take on priority tasks such as Audit or Assurance Readiness, Operational Resilience project, with emphasis on adherence to quality of deliverables and timelines. Participate in validating the design and operating effectiveness of the key controls through inspection, inquiry, observation, sampling, re-performance and recalculation. Participate in activities to help ensure control assessments are accurate, effective, comply with procedures and templates, and meet quality control requirements. Identify trends to anticipate future developments in the risk and control environment: core risk types. Review and research moderately complex potential corrective actions, and follow through on reporting, escalation, and resolution Ensure effective and appropriate testing, validation, and documentation of review activities for risk programs and controls according to standards and other applicable policies Resolve moderately complex issues and lead team to meet Independent Testing deliverables while leveraging solid understanding of risk management framework and the risk and control environment Collaborate and consult with colleagues, internal partners, management and lines of business regarding risk management.

Designation: Operational risk analyst Department: Risk Management Company: Citi Corp Services India Pvt Ltd (March ‘2023 – January 2025)
Roles and Responsibilities
Performing evidence-based control evaluations by conducting various evidence gathering activities on

mortgage related activities Strong relationships with businesses, change programs, Operational Risk & Compliance and Audit to identify opportunities to share and enhance operational risk and compliance practices
Generating fail reports for analyzing the potential risks exposed and controls to be implemented. • Work with Operations standards team to identify the process gaps and take measures in mitigating the same.
Monitoring of key risk metrics, and help the business to determine actions to take to manage risk and compliance effectively
Participates in team meetings to analyze documentation and processes to ensure risks and control points are properly addressed.
Weekly error analysis and shares the output with the management • Getting training from Onshore for any new process and imparting knowledge to the team. • • Sending out daily, weekly, and monthly productivity, volume and ageing report to the management. Act as SME to stakeholders and/or other team members.
Designation: Sr. Operations Analyst Department: Retail Business Banking (Collateralization of Secured Loans and Credits) Company: Citi Corp Services India Pvt Ltd (February ‘2021 – March 2023)
Roles and Responsibilities
Performed tracking and monitoring activities of collaterals for secured loans within CITIBANK retail business banking portfolio, adhered to SLAs and 100% quality
Performing post closure audits by verifying the collateral documents and reconciling the same with Credit approval summary (CAS)
Rendering support to credit team by providing weekly payoff reports in order to untie the collaterals and ensuring there is no customer impact or reputational discomfort to CITIBANK
Assisting KYC teams by furnishing required documents and collateral data in their requisite documents such as cross collateralization
Actively participated in cross connect sessions to deepen process knowledge and quest for collaborating opportunities between departments in order to eliminate dependencies, redundancies and pave way for process improvement
Assisted process leads in preparing and designing value stream mapping presentations.
Maintained excellent rapport with stateside partners (CITIBANK N.A) to check on process updates
Designation- Deputy manager
Department-Customer service Company: ICICI Bank Ltd (2016 January – 2021 January)
Roles and Responsibilities
Understanding customers financial needs, provide solutions and give high priority to customer satisfaction.
Understand business and regulatory requirements and ensure functions are being performed within those requirements

Ensuring KYC checks when on-boarding a new client
Reconciliation of office accounts
Performing Compliance, service, operations in branch and ensuring all regulatory and statutory requirements.
Application of all standard checks and controls during every product sale and co-ordinate with other team; Product/Operations/Technology/Compliance.
Cross checking of financial and Non-Financial vouchers before auditing, performing ATM and recycler cash audits.
ADDITIONALQUALIFICATIONS
Imarticus Learning
Certified Investment Banking Operations Professional • AML/KYC, Asset Management, Risk Management • •
Securities and Derivatives, End to end Trade life cycle of Listed and OTC products Functioning of Clearing and Settlement systems
Diploma In Banking Operations from NIIT – IFBI, Batch 2015
Customer due diligence –AML controls and procedures, KYC procedures
